inputs.text: Canada is tightening immigration and asylum rules affecting Nigerians and others after Bill C-12 received royal assent on March 26, 2026. This is a troubling turn toward treating migration as a security problem rather than protecting people seeking safety. When governments harden borders, the costs fall hardest on migrants already facing unequal power and precarious circumstances.
